daemon: KILO_NO_DAEMON=1 prevents daemon attachment. HR1 guarantees stop cleanup on Linux. On macOS, a detached persistent background process Kilo starts may outlive stop if orphaned before it is recorded and its output is closed or redirected. Live check #2443 covers this platform claim.
